attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited has submitted the audio recording of the group conference call held on November 13, 2026, to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. The call discussed financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available at https://www.eicher.in/quarterly-results and on the company website at www.eichermotors.com. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The submission was made by Atul Sharma, Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 25910 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited has approved the allotment of 25,910 equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each to persons exercising stock options under the Employees Stock Option Plan 2006 and Restricted Stock Units Plan 2019. This decision was taken by the Board of Directors during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The meeting commenced at 11:05 a.m. and concluded at 3:45 p.m. The company has intimated this outcome to the BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 with the BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The presentation covers the company overview, Royal Enfield business segments including India and international operations, and a joint venture update with VECV. Shareholding data as of September 30, 2026, indicates the Promoter Group holds 45.6 percent, Domestic Institutional Investors hold 27.1 percent, Foreign Institutional Investors hold 14.9 percent, and Others hold 8.9 percent. The board of directors includes Siddhartha Lal as Executive Chairman and B. Govindarajan as Managing Director. The document outlines a strategic vision focusing on balancing ICE and EV products, brand-led customer experience, and sustainability. It also details Royal Enfield's product launches and manufacturing facility updates through 2026.

attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Opening of Trading Window'.
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited has intimated that its trading window for insiders will open on November 16, 2026. The window remains open until further communication is announced. This action follows the company's Code of Conduct for Regulating, Monitoring and Reporting Trading by an Insider under the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. The intimation was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd on November 13, 2026. Atul Sharma, Company Secretary, issued the notice on behalf of the company.

attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "EICHER MOTORS DELIVERS BEST-EVER QUARTER WITH HIGHEST-EVER REVENUE AND EBITDA".
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited consolidated financial results for the second quarter of FY 2026-27 ended September 30, 2026. The company reported best-ever Revenue from operations at Rs. 7,422 crores, up 20 percent year-on-year. EBITDA grew 16 percent to Rs. 1,760 crores. Profit After Tax rose 15 percent to Rs. 1,573 crores. Royal Enfield recorded highest-ever quarterly sales of 376,722 motorcycles, up 15 percent. VE Commercial Vehicles recorded best-ever Q2 sales of 28,071 vehicles, up 28.2 percent. VECV Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 7,569 crores, up 24 percent. VECV EBITDA rose 23 percent to Rs. 588 crores. VECV Profit after tax stood at Rs. 342 crores.

attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 7,159.04 Crores for the quarter and 13,372.65 Crores for the half year. Profit for the period was 1,324.99 Crores for the quarter and 2,831.61 Crores for the half year. Basic earnings per share stood at 48.27 for the quarter and 103.18 for the half year. The statutory auditors, S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP, issued a review report confirming no material misstatements were identified. The results will be published in newspapers and on the company website.

attchmntText: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Eicher Motors Limited has scheduled a group conference call for Friday, November 13, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call will commence after the conclusion of the Board meeting. Speakers include Mr. B Govindarajan, Managing Director of EML and CEO of Royal Enfield; Mr. B Srinivas, Managing Director and CEO of VE Commercial Vehicles; and Ms. Vidhya Srinivasan, Chief Financial Officer of Eicher Motors Ltd. The event is led by Amit Hiranandani of PhillipCapital India. Dial-in details and registration links are provided in the invitation. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.
